steps.description: Add ≥2 Section Challenge blocks to `22_DevOps/07_DNS*.md`: cover DNS resolution flow, TTL strategy, DNS security (DNSSEC, DoH), record types.
Add ≥2 Section Challenge blocks to `22_DevOps/08_HTTP*.md`: cover HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, status codes, headers, caching, TLS handshake.
Add ≥2 Section Challenge blocks to `22_DevOps/14_SSH*.md`: cover SSH key auth, port forwarding (local/remote/dynamic), agent forwarding, jump hosts, security hardening.
Add ≥2 Section Challenge blocks to `22_DevOps/20_Terraform*.md`: cover state management, plan/apply workflow, modules, workspaces, drift detection.
Add ≥2 Section Challenge blocks to `22_DevOps/22_SRE*.md`: cover SLOs/SLIs/SLAs, error budgets, incident response, post-mortems, on-call.

phases.name: Verification and Report
phases.goal: Verify all 8 modified DevOps files meet the gold standard; produce final verification report.

steps.description: Run quality verification: wc -l on all 8 files, grep -c Section Challenge for all 8 files, verify no 00_CONTEXT/ modifications by this ferment via git diff --stat.

verification.command: for f in 22_DevOps/12_WiFi_AP_Enterprise.md 22_DevOps/13_Cloud_Networking_VPC.md 22_DevOps/17_Docker_Complete.md 22_DevOps/07_DNS*.md 22_DevOps/08_HTTP*.md 22_DevOps/14_SSH*.md 22_DevOps/20_Terraform*.md 22_DevOps/22_SRE*.md; do echo "$f: $(wc -l < $f) lines, $(grep -c 'Section Challenge' $f) challenges"; done

steps.description: Write final verification report at .kimchi/ferments/019eea79-6cde-7554-907c-7aad38f7964c/docs/DEVOPS_GAP_FILL_REPORT.md: list all 8 files with before/after line counts, challenge block counts, sample challenge topics, contamination check.
